overviewParagraphs: Custom embroidered patches are made by stitching thread onto a fabric base to create logos, badges, text and decorative designs. The raised thread texture creates a classic, premium look recognized across industries worldwide.

Compared with printed labels, embroidered patches offer proven durability, a traditional aesthetic and the widest range of applications — from corporate uniforms to sports merchandise to fashion branding. Good for medium-complexity logos and traditional patch designs.

faqs.question: What are custom embroidered patches best for?
faqs.answer: Embroidered patches are best for classic logo patches, uniforms, jackets, hats, clubs, teams, brand merchandise and promotional products where a raised stitched texture and traditional appearance are desired.

faqs.question: Can embroidered patches show very small text?
faqs.answer: Embroidered patches can reproduce most logo details well, but very small text (under ~5mm) may not be as sharp as woven patches. Our team can advise on the best patch type for your design.

faqs.question: What backing options are available?
faqs.answer: Sew-on, iron-on, Velcro and adhesive backing are all available. Sew-on is the most durable; iron-on is convenient for fabric production; Velcro is best for removable patches; adhesive works for temporary applications.

faqs.question: Can I order custom sizes and shapes?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support fully custom sizes from 1″ to 15″+ and any shape — standard geometric, contour-cut or fully custom die-cut.

faqs.question: How do I get a quote?
faqs.answer: Upload your artwork through our Request a Quote page and provide patch size, quantity, backing option and delivery requirements. We respond with a detailed quote — typically within 1 business day.
